```{R}
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(knitr)
```

```{R}
#| label: data-dictionary-major-salaries
#| tbl-cap: "Data dictionary for `ai_salary_majors`"

data_dict <- tribble(
  ~Variable,                 ~Type,       ~Description,
  "field_of_study",          "character", "Name of the college major",
  "broad_field_short",       "character", "Short label for the major's broad field (CIP family)",
  "median_starting_salary",  "double",    "Median earnings one year after graduation (USD)",
  "median_salary_4yr",       "double",    "Median earnings four years after graduation (USD); missing for 8 majors",
  "ai_exposure",             "double",    "How much a major's typical jobs rely on abilities related to common AI applications (standardized; 0 = average occupation, higher = more exposed)",
  "ai_exposure_language",    "double",    "AI exposure based only on language modeling",
  "ai_exposure_image",       "double",    "AI exposure based only on image generation",
  "n_occupations",           "integer",   "Number of occupations the major maps to",
  "n_graduates",             "double",    "Total graduates with measured earnings one year out"
)

data_dict |>
  kable() |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) |>
  column_spec(1, monospace = TRUE) |>
  column_spec(3, width = "20em")
```
```{R}
#| label: data-dictionary-occupations
#| tbl-cap: "Data dictionary for `major_occupations`"

occ_dict <- tribble(
  ~Variable,               ~Type,       ~Description,
  "cip4",                  "character", "Four-digit CIP 2020 code for the major; joins to `ai_salary_majors`",
  "field_of_study",        "character", "Name of the college major",
  "soc",                   "character", "Six-digit SOC 2018 occupation code",
  "occupation",            "character", "Occupation title",
  "ai_exposure",           "double",    "AI exposure for this occupation (standardized; 0 = average occupation, higher = more exposed)",
  "ai_exposure_language",  "double",    "AI exposure for this occupation based only on language modeling",
  "ai_exposure_image",     "double",    "AI exposure for this occupation based only on image generation"
)

occ_dict |>
  kable() |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE) |>
  column_spec(1, monospace = TRUE) |>
  column_spec(3, width = "20em")
```
